title: Catalog of assistants
description: A published (https) list of assistants, by where their package is. K-Desktop reads it in Settings → Catalog; of each package it only reads its assistant.json and its icon, with range requests: the name, description, version and what it needs come from the package, not from here.

id.description: The id of its assistant.json (if it does not match, it is not offered).

package.description: Where its latest .kai always is (on GitHub, releases/latest/download/…). http only to this PC, for testing.
